text:
I found a plan that misses no (episode, follower) pairs. It costs 7 periods: 3 × Marquee, 2 × Lumen and 2 × Northline, for $97.91 in total.

**How many periods each service needs**
- **Marquee** (The Glass Archive and The Velvet Garden) needs 3 periods.
  - Access must reach back to 11-20 (Glass Archive episode 1 window ends) and forward to 02-08 (Velvet Garden episode 10 window starts). That is about 80 days.
  - Two monthly periods give about 61 days. Episodes from the two shows come out every 3–4 days, so any gap longer than about a week would swallow a whole 8-day window. Two periods cannot stretch far enough.
  - The already-paid access (until 11-08) ends before the first episode on 11-13, so it does not help.
- **Lumen** (The Northern Kingdom) needs 2 periods: 01-08 and 02-15.
  - The first runs 01-08 to 02-07 and catches episode 1 (window 01-01 to 01-08) on its last day.
  - The 7-day gap from 02-08 to 02-14 cannot contain a full 8-day window. Episode 6 is caught by 02-07 and episode 7 by 02-15.
  - The second runs 02-15 to 03-14 and covers episode 11 (window 03-12 to 03-19).
- **Northline** needs 2 periods.
  - One period in November covers Distant Meridian (available until 11-23).
  - One period from 02-08 to 03-07 covers the other three titles:
    - The Salt Atlas, on 02-08, the last day of its window.
    - Quiet Signal (02-09 to 03-13).
    - Glass Circuit (02-24 to 04-02).

**Fitting under the limit of 2 services at once**
- On 11-01 Lumen and Marquee both have already-paid access, so nothing new can start that day. Northline therefore starts 11-02.
- From 02-15 to 03-07, Lumen and Northline are both active. Marquee must therefore finish by 02-14 while still having access on some day from 02-08 on.
  - Running Marquee back-to-back from 11-14 to 02-13 does this, and it still catches Glass Archive episode 1 (window 11-13 to 11-20).
- I checked the count by stretch of dates:

| Dates | Services with access | Count |
|---|---|---|
| 11-01 | Lumen, Marquee (already paid) | 2 |
| 11-02 to 11-07 | Northline, Marquee (already paid) | 2 |
| 11-14 to 12-01 | Northline, Marquee | 2 |
| 12-02 to 01-07 | Marquee | 1 |
| 01-08 to 02-07 | Marquee, Lumen | 2 |
| 02-08 to 02-13 | Marquee, Northline | 2 |
| 02-15 to 03-07 | Lumen, Northline | 2 |
